senses.gloss:
गोचर m. (-रः)
 1. An object of sense, as sound, shape, colour, &c.
 2. A.
country, a district.
 3. The house or mansion of a planet, or its
presence in any sign which is that of a person's nativity.
 4. Pas-
turage.
 E. गो an organ of sense, &c. and चर what goes, from चर् to
go, निपातने अच् aff.

गोचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म)
 1. A cow's hide.
 2. A hide of land, 300 feet long, by
10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of
which will support a man for a year.
 E. गो and चर्म्मन् skin.

गोचारक m. (-कः) A cowhered.
 E. गो, चर to go, causal form णिच् ण्वुल् aff.
